canon_verification._comment_enabled: Opt-in flag. Default false. Set true to activate the verifier.
_comment_canon_paths: Array of paths to adopter canon markdown files.
Paths are relative to the repo root where verify-canon.py runs.
Upstream (juvantlabs/juvant-os) ships no canon paths — this block
lives entirely in the adopter's fork or config overlay.
Cross-repo: if canon lives in a sibling repo, use a CI checkout step
to place it at a known relative path before running the verifier.
_comment_check_classes: Subset of the nine perimeter check classes to activate.
Omit this key to activate all nine classes.
Classes requiring external tools (4-9) are silently skipped if the
required tool is unavailable or the required config key is absent.
_comment_gh_project_id: GitHub ProjectV2 node ID — required for check class 4 (gh_project_fields).
Retrieve with: gh api graphql -f query='{ viewer { projectsV2(first:10)
_comment_github_repos: Inherited from the top-level github_repos array for milestone lookups
(check class 5). Defined once at top level; referenced here for clarity.
